title: Wildlife Watching in the UK: Puffins, Seals and More
description: Wildlife watching with kids in the UK: puffins, seals, dolphins, deer and birds of prey, with tips on boat trips and watching animals responsibly.
intro: Puffins with rainbow beaks, seals lounging on rocks and deer in the autumn mist. Britain’s wild animals make for a brilliant family day out.

image.alt: A boy feeding deer through a fence

cardText: Puffins, seals, dolphins and deer: when and where to look.

blocks.title: Scout’s wildlife code
blocks.text: Keep your distance, stay quiet and never feed wild animals. Binoculars make it more exciting than getting closer!
points: Puffins are seasonal: roughly spring to midsummer

sections.html:
• Puffins: nest on islands and cliffs from around spring into midsummer.
  • Seals: visible on many coasts year-round. Some areas see pups in autumn and winter.
  • Dolphins: seen from some coasts and boat trips.
  • Deer: the autumn rut is dramatic. Watch from a safe distance.
Choose operators who follow wildlife watching codes, and check age rules and weather cancellations. Pack layers. It’s colder at sea.
See nature and national parks and zoos and aquariums for guaranteed sightings.

faqs.q: When can you see puffins in the UK?
faqs.a: Puffins come ashore to nest from around spring until midsummer, then head back out to sea. Check with local reserves for the best times.
